items.title: DIAL rains for relief: Choked Delhi to see another cloud seeding attempt
items.author: SAURABH SINHA
items.description: India’s capital, New Delhi, will attempt cloud seeding to induce rain and address severe pollution. The initiative involves Delhi International Airport Ltd, the Delhi government, and IIT Kanpur. A specialized aircraft from Kyathi Climate will undertake the operation on Tuesday and Wednesday. A fresh western disturbance is expected to bring rain to northwestern India later this week. Cloud seeding aims to enhance precipitation as the air quality deteriorates.

items.title: Bank stocks lead market recovery as Nifty closes above 25,000
items.description: On Monday, market indices Sensex and Nifty showed a recovery following heavy intraday losses. Investors reacted positively to gains in banking stocks driven by foreign purchases and falling crude oil prices. The Sensex closed at 81,106.65, rising 107.25 points, while the Nifty ended at 25,044.65 after gaining 58.25 points. Additionally, the Nifty PSU Bank index surged almost 4%, making it the top-performing sectoral index.

items.title: Rural tech initiative reaches 25,000 farmers across 300 villages
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Saksham Kumar established Tech on the Field with a mission to empower rural farmers by imparting knowledge about modern agricultural technologies, significantly enhancing their livelihoods. This impressive initiative has engaged over 25,000 farmers in 300 villages, hosting 250 workshops in five districts. Moreover, Kumar’s intervention has seen 20,000 farmers enroll in government assistance programs and 15,000 linked to vital produce markets, leading to a notable 10% hike in their incomes.
